H7143.name: Kareah
H7143.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7143.short: Kareah was the father of Johanan and Jonathan, two military leaders who joined Gedaliah after the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

H7163.name: Keren-happuch
H7163.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7163.brief: Job's third daughter born after his restoration
H7163.short: Keren-happuch was the name of Job's third daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

H7103.name: Keziah
H7103.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7103.brief: Job's second daughter born after his restoration
H7103.short: Keziah was the name of Job's second daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

H7141J.name: Korah
H7141J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7141J.brief: Son of Hebron, descendant of Caleb
H7141J.short: Korah, son of Hebron, from the tribe of Judah.

H7141I.name: Korah
H7141I.desc: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7141I.brief: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants
H7141I.short: Korah, a Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron; his descendants became temple musicians and gatekeepers.

H7141H.name: Korah
H7141H.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7141H.short: Korah, an Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz, son of Esau.

H7141G.name: Korah
H7141G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7141G.short: Korah, son of Esau and Oholibamah

H7173.name: Karka
H7173.brief: A place on the southern border of Judah
H7173.short: Karka, a location along the southern border of the tribe of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:3">Joshua 15:3</ref>).

H7174.name: Karkor
H7174.brief: A place where Gideon defeated Zebah and Zalmunna
H7174.short: Karkor, the place where Gideon defeated the Midianite kings Zebah and Zalmunna (<ref="Judges 8:10">Judges 8:10</ref>).

H7178.name: Kartan
H7178.brief: A Levitical city in the territory of Naphtali
H7178.short: Kartan, a city given to the Levites within the territory of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 21:32">Joshua 21:32</ref>).

H7152G.name: Kerioth-hezron
H7152G.brief: A town in the Negev region of Judah
H7152G.short: Kerioth-hezron, also known as Hazor, was a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:25">Joshua 15:25</ref>).

H7156I.name: Kiriathaim
H7156I.short: Kiriathaim, a Levitical city in the territory of Reuben (<ref="1Ch.6.76">1Ch.6.76</ref>).

H7156G.name: Kiriathaim
H7156G.brief: A Moabite city, later allotted to Reuben
H7156G.short: Kiriathaim, also known as Kerioth, was a Moabite city later allotted to the tribe of Reuben (<ref="Numbers 32:37; Joshua 13:19; Jeremiah 48:1">Numbers 32:37; Joshua 13:19; Jeremiah 48:1, 23</ref>).

H7155.name: Kiriath-huzoth
H7155.short: Kiriath-huzoth, a place where Balak took Balaam (<ref="Numbers 22:39">Numbers 22:39</ref>).

H7157.name: Kiriath-jearim
H7157.brief: A city where the ark resided
H7157.short: Kiriath-jearim, a city where the ark of the covenant resided for 20 years (<ref="1Sa.7.1-2">1Sa.7.1-2</ref>).

H7191.name: Kishion
H7191.short: Kishion (Kedesh), a Levitical city in the territory of Issachar (<ref="Joshua 19:20, 21:28; 1Ch.6.72">Joshua 19:20, 21:28; 1Ch.6.72</ref>).
